implementation.scope: Two adjacent direct-call-free PPC bodies: two-word keyed chained lookup and low-16 character flag table/mask. Full selected live GPR, CR0/CR6, XER, stack spill and ordinary RAM comparison.

validation.tested_scope: No buckets, nonpositive count, bucket sentinel, direct and collision hits, chain miss, character-mask hit and index 255/256/65535. Complete pinned PPC bodies on original side; selected full GPR/SP/LR/CTR, CR0/CR6/XER, key spill and ordinary RAM.
validation.unvalidated_scope: Other inputs/aliasing, faults, MMIO, concurrency, unselected ABI and runtime.
